prompt:
Create one transparent-background sprite atlas in crisp pixel-art style. Use the first reference contact as the ONLY authority for the three Dungeon After Dark objects identity, materials, palette, layout, and details. Read its rows in this order: ghost-cemetery-burial-niche-wall; ghost-cemetery-la-iglesia-de-los-olvidados-entrance; ghost-cemetery-spirit-box-trap. Each row shows source, FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Use the second reference only as geometry guidance for the niche wall and church entrance overhead/underside footprints; do not copy its colors or pixels. Preserve all distinctive designs and counts from the first reference.

Output a clean 6-column x 3-row atlas, square cells, no labels or gutters. Columns in exact order: FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Row order same as above. Every cell contains one complete isolated object, centered, no clipping, no neighboring objects, transparent around silhouette. Axis-aligned orthographic principal views only; no isometric, no perspective, no tilt. Upright walls and church facades have broad FRONT/REAR, thin RIGHT/LEFT edges. TOP/BOTTOM look exactly along world +Z/-Z; preserve consistent footprints. Treat FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR as style/material references; only TOP and BOTTOM are new targets, and they must remain consistent with the same physical object.

Row1 burial niche wall: preserve the exact 3-by-3 niche wall. Since FRONT/REAR and sides show an upright thin-depth wall, TOP is a narrow horizontal stone-and-moss wall-cap strip spanning the wall width, not a full 3x3 face plan; BOTTOM is a corresponding narrow opaque masonry underside strip, no frontal niche openings, no flames or flowers underneath. Keep all nine niches visible only in elevations.

Row2 church entrance: source and FRONT/REAR establish a shallow upright church portal with pitched roof, central doorway, and a vertical cross above the roof. TOP is a shallow long-X roof/lintel footprint matching the side-view depth; show only roof cap/roof ridgeline and compact end-on cross cap, never the frontal triangular pediment, full crucifix face, or vertical doorway. BOTTOM is a matching narrow stone foundation/root underside, no full facade triangle or cross face.

Row3 spirit box trap: retain the exact upright stone-framed circular mechanism with four corner caps and blue/gold ring. TOP is the thin upper rim/stone frame footprint at the shared front-to-back depth; do not show the full frontal ring face laid flat. BOTTOM is the matching narrow stone/base underside with four compact corner-cap undersides and any physically visible support, not the full front/rear face or a square floor plinth. Keep ring mechanism and cap count intact in every elevation; no new symbols.

The target art should stay coherent with its source and any approved geometry guidance while clearly showing the assigned principal planes. Use shared scales within each row. Leave generous transparent cell margins so no artwork touches atlas cell borders.
